title.zh: 无共同引用的关联问题丢失真实接续
title.en: Unanchored incidence questions lose real continuation distinctions

claim.zh: 任意两个有局部左右单位的接合结构中，所有片段在无引用关联语言中同测。该粗说明对这套问题精确且最小，却可把同一已消耗历史的不可自接合误成可自接合。
claim.en: All fragments in any two joining structures with local left/right units agree in the unanchored incidence language. The coarse account is exact and reduced for that language yet can turn the same spent history’s impossible self-join into a possible one.

hypotheses.zh: HasUnits 对一般退化定理；具体反例复用 budgetProcess 的 admitted histories、trace_has_units 和 spend_cannot_self_join。
hypotheses.en: HasUnits for the general collapse; the concrete case reuses budgetProcess admitted histories, trace_has_units and spend_cannot_self_join.

correspondence.zh: 反例在已有单次消耗过程中比较真实片段与其粗代码；遗漏的是固定输入关系，不是任意本体身份或自由切换的谓词。
correspondence.en: The example compares an actual fragment of the existing one-use process with its coarse code; the omission is fixed-input joining, not arbitrary ontological identity or a freely toggled predicate.

detail.zh: 单位置提升映射的问答保真接入退化说明。
detail.en: Question fidelity of one-position lifting maps feeds the collapse account.

input.zh: units_collapse_open 从单位给出到单片段结构的 OpenMap，再得到所有片段同测。
input.en: units_collapse_open constructs an OpenMap to the singleton structure from local units, then yields agreement of all fragments.

conditions.zh: 保留局部左右单位及同一关联语言；不需要经典有限分支恢复。
conditions.en: Retain local left/right units and the same incidence language; classical finite-branch recovery is not required.

detail.zh: 保留同一配置的共同引用修复具体丢失。
detail.en: Shared reference within a retained configuration repairs the concrete loss.

detail.zh: 同一研究中的接续成果；具体正式复用另列，关联不自动构成已证转换。
detail.en: Continuation result in the same study; formal reuse is listed separately, and this relationship does not itself assert a checked adapter.

detail.zh: 同一研究中的接续成果；具体正式复用另列，关联不自动构成已证转换。
detail.en: Continuation result in the same study; formal reuse is listed separately, and this relationship does not itself assert a checked adapter.

detail.zh: 同一研究的新接续；具体形式复用另列，此关联不独自证明转换。
detail.en: New continuation in the same study; formal reuse is specified separately, without a proved adapter inferred from this relation.

detail.zh: 同一研究的新接续；具体形式复用另列，此关联不独自证明转换。
detail.en: New continuation in the same study; formal reuse is specified separately, without a proved adapter inferred from this relation.

detail.zh: 否定的是无引用语言足以解释完整接合的候选推论；不是生成基础不可能。局部单位不由本轮证明为普遍条件；退化定理不需有限性。
detail.en: Refutes the candidate inference that unanchored questions suffice for full joining, not the possibility of generative grounding. Local units are not proved universal; the collapse theorem needs no finiteness.

limitations.zh: 否定的是无引用语言足以解释完整接合的候选推论；不是生成基础不可能。局部单位不由本轮证明为普遍条件；退化定理不需有限性。
limitations.en: Refutes the candidate inference that unanchored questions suffice for full joining, not the possibility of generative grounding. Local units are not proved universal; the collapse theorem needs no finiteness.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 实查：本次43项新声明，213项继承审计，共256项；新9空依赖、34标准，7项含经典选择。冻结源码、日志与回执逐字绑定；非独立 agent 验收。
validation_scope.en: Lean 4.29.1 checks 43 new declarations and 213 inherited audits, 256 total; new 9 empty and 34 standard dependency lists, 7 with classical choice. Frozen source/logs bind to the receipt; no independent-agent acceptance.

next_delta.zh: 复用有限条件程序与真实余项恢复；继续建立内部语法不同的说明之间余项、判断与实际形成关系的有据翻译，区分语义可判定与实际取得。
next_delta.en: Reuse finite guarded programs and coherent residual recovery; establish warranted residual/guard/formation translation between descriptions with different internal syntax, distinguishing semantic tests from actual acquisition.

history.en: 2026-10-08: continued the existing joining-context study, with distinct scopes for common refinement, compatible factors, real information loss and retained-reference repair.

history.en: 2026-10-09: reuse this result in finite-granularity continuation; preserve its claim, hypotheses and proof bindings. New prefix omission and resumption testing appear in the same study §§22–26.

history.en: 2026-10-09 continuation: finite guarded programs, residual recovery and 35 checked declarations added in the same study §§27–32; this result retains its claim, assumptions and proof bindings.
